title: bidens aristosa var. retrorsa
intro: Bidens aristosa var. retrorsa, commonly known as twisted beggar-ticks, is a plant species that belongs to the aster family. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
